excerpt.zh: 这个星系中有大量的超空间航道。通常情况下，我们会认为它们太小了，宇宙飞船无法在其中航行，但是它们的数量本身就很惊人。
excerpt.en: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.

texts.zh:
那些星球是被移动了！

我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系探测到的异常超空间航道都连接着我们认为应该存在星球的位置。在研究了这些怪异的航道后，我们发现它们都通向同一个地方。一个叫做达恰的恒星系，本以为是无法到达的，但如果把这些狭窄的超空间航道合并起来，我们就能送一艘科研船过去。
texts.en:
The planets were moved!

The abnormal hyperlanes we detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system were each tethered to where we previously had expected to discover worlds. After studying these strange lanes, we realize they all lead to the same place. A star system called Dacha, which was thought unreachable, yet if we were to combine all these slender hyperlanes, we could pass a science ship through.

label.zh: 找到超空间航道通往何处！
label.en: Find out where the hyperlanes lead!
Do we really want to know?

# 失踪的行星 / The Missing Planets

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:703-715` · `events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:6661-6699 (fircon.5000)` · `events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:6751-6887 (fircon.5010)` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1050, 1163`
- DLC：第一次接触 First Contact（事件文件 first_contact_dlc_events.txt） / First Contact (event file first_contact_dlc_events.txt)
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 部分审阅 Partial

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 7级异常，不会随机生成：舰队首次进入特殊星系（solarpunk_system_01）时 fircon.5000（另一故事，C7）在恒星上添加本异常。  
  Level-7 anomaly that never spawns randomly: fircon.5000 (another story, C7) adds it to the star when a fleet first enters the special system solarpunk_system_01.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- fircon.5010“星球大盗”：星系中异常多的微小超空间航道都通向被认为无法到达的“达恰”星系。探查（全局首次时生成达恰星系与前超光速的“哈宾特联合世界”，物理研究）；或不想知道（物理研究）。  
  fircon.5010 "Grand Theft Planet": the thin hyperlanes all lead to the unreachable Dacha system. Investigate (the first time in the galaxy this spawns Dacha and the pre-FTL Habinte Unified Worlds; physics) or not (physics).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 后续（勘察哈宾特世界 fircon.5020 等）在C7的哈宾特故事中。  
  The continuation (surveying the Habinte worlds, fircon.5020 and later) is in the C7 Habinte stories.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.
